tasks.title: FormulaFunction declares its arity as a tuple
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: FormulaFunction no longer has minArgs/maxArgs. It declares `arity: [min, max]` (max is Infinity for variadic functions), and the evaluator reads `fn.arity` to check argument counts. Update src/core/types.ts and src/eval/evaluate.ts, migrate every existing function module and test, update the README example, and add tests/core/co-arity-tuple.test.ts covering the new contract.
Done when tests/core/co-arity-tuple.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: Rename formatGeneral to numberToText
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `formatGeneral(n)` in src/core/coerce.ts is renamed to `numberToText(n)` (same behaviour: the General number format, at most 15 significant digits). Remove the old name, update every caller and test, and add tests/core/co-number-to-text.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-number-to-text.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: flattenArgs takes required options
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `flattenArgs(args)` becomes `flattenArgs(args, opts)` where `opts: FlattenOptions` is required and says what to do with empty values: `{ blanks: 'keep' }` keeps them as null (the old behaviour) and `{ blanks: 'skip' }` drops them. Migrate every caller (keeping today's behaviour) and add tests/core/co-flatten-opts.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-flatten-opts.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: firstError takes an array
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `firstError(...values)` becomes `firstError(values)`, taking one array (`firstError([a, b])`), so it can be used directly on argument lists. Migrate every caller and test and add tests/core/co-first-error-array.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-first-error-array.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: dimensions returns { height, width }
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `dimensions(value)` in src/core/range.ts returns `{ height, width }` instead of a `[height, width]` tuple. Migrate every caller and test and add tests/core/co-dimensions-object.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-dimensions-object.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: RangeValue becomes immutable
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: RangeValue no longer exposes its `rows` array and can no longer be built with `new`. Build ranges with `RangeValue.fromRows(rows)` and read them with `.at(r, c)`, `.height`, `.width` or `.toRows()` (which returns a copy). Store the cells privately. Migrate every caller and test and add tests/core/co-range-immutable.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-range-immutable.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: compareScalars takes required options
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `compareScalars(a, b)` becomes `compareScalars(a, b, opts)` with a required `opts: CompareOptions` (`{ caseSensitive: boolean }`), so functions such as EXACT-style lookups can compare text case-sensitively. `scalarsEqual(a, b)` keeps its signature (case-insensitive). Migrate every caller (keeping today's case-insensitive behaviour) and add tests/core/co-compare-opts.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-compare-opts.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: Explicit integer rounding: toIntTrunc / toIntFloor
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `toInteger` in src/core/coerce.ts is removed. Use `toIntTrunc` (truncate toward zero, the old behaviour) or the new `toIntFloor` (round down). Migrate every caller (keeping truncation) and test, and add tests/core/co-to-int-explicit.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-to-int-explicit.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: toBoolean takes required options
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `toBoolean(value)` becomes `toBoolean(value, opts)` with a required `opts: BooleanOptions` (`{ text: 'parse' | 'reject' }`): 'parse' reads "TRUE"/"FALSE" text as today, 'reject' gives #VALUE! for any text. Migrate every caller (keeping today's behaviour) and test, and add tests/core/co-to-boolean-opts.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-to-boolean-opts.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: optional* helpers take the argument value
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `optionalNumber(args, i, fallback)` (and optionalInteger / optionalBoolean / optionalText) become `optionalNumber(args[i], fallback)`: they take the argument value itself (undefined when omitted). Migrate every caller and test, and add tests/core/co-optional-arg-value.test.ts.
Done when tests/core/co-optional-arg-value.test.ts and the rest of the suite pass.

tasks.title: Rename checkNumber to numberResult
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `checkNumber(n)` in src/core/coerce.ts is renamed to `numberResult(n)` (same behaviour: NaN and ±Infinity become #NUM!, -0 becomes 0). Remove the old name, migrate every caller and test, and add tests/core/co-check-number-rename.test.ts.

tasks.title: cellsOf takes a required traversal order
tasks.prompt:
Contract change: `cellsOf(value)` in src/core/range.ts becomes `cellsOf(value, opts)` with a required `opts: CellOrder` (`{ order: 'rows' | 'columns' }`): 'rows' is today's row-by-row order, 'columns' walks column by column.
